	+ **Power BI** for analytics and visualisation
	+ **Power Automate** for workflow and process automation
	+ **Power Apps** for digital forms, data capture, and process enablement

* Design integrated workflows connecting project data, approvals, alerts, and reporting outputs.
* Promote a **digital\-first approach** to reporting, governance, and information management.
* Propose and implement practical automation solutions that improve efficiency, control, and user experience.

* Promote use of **advanced Excel, Power Query, DAX, SQL, Python, and modern data engineering practices** where appropriate.
* Explore opportunities to apply **advanced analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and automation** to improve efficiency and insight generation.

**7\. PMO, Project Controls \& Business Integration**

* Work closely with **PMO Leads, Project Controls teams, Commercial teams, and Delivery stakeholders** to align analytics outputs with business and project needs.
* Ensure reporting supports visibility across Cost, Schedule, Risk, Commercial performance, Resource and delivery metrics
* Integrate analytics outputs with project controls and PMO processes to strengthen governance and decision\-making.

* Enable joined\-up reporting across PMO, controls, commercial, and operational functions.

* Present insights through governance forums, showcases, leadership reviews, and stakeholder meetings.

description:
**Company Description**

  

Tradeweb is a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes. As financial markets become increasingly interconnected, our technology enables efficient, multi\-asset trading on a global scale. We serve more than 3,000 clients in more than 85 countries, including many of the world’s largest banks, asset managers, hedge funds, insurers, corporations, and wealth managers.


Creative collaboration and sharp client focus have helped fuel our organic growth. We facilitated average daily trading volume (ADV) of more than $2\.8 trillion over the past four fiscal quarters, topping $3\.3 trillion in ADV for the first quarter of 2026\.


Since our IPO in 2019, Tradeweb has completed four acquisitions and doubled our revenues – and 2025 was our 26th consecutive year of record revenues.


Tradeweb plays a central role in modernizing market structure by developing innovative trading protocols, embedding analytics into execution, and building technology infrastructure that supports the convergence of traditional and digitally native financial markets. Tradeweb is a great place to work, recognized in 2025 by Forbes as one of *America’s Best Companies* and by U.S. News \& World Report as one of the *Best Financial Services Companies to Work For* .


As a technology\-driven organization, we value individuals who embrace innovation and are eager to leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency, enhance decision\-making, and deliver better outcomes for clients and colleagues. We believe the greatest impact comes from combining technological capabilities with human expertise, judgment, and accountability


**Group Details**

We are recruiting an Environmental Data Analyst to support the preparation, maintenance and assurance of our greenhouse gas (GHG) inventory. This is a data\-driven role: the organization reports emissions across multiple cycles each year, to more than one set of stakeholders and under more than one assurance process, and the analyst keeps that data accurate, traceable and on time.


The role centers on four areas: data collection and validation across GHG inventory books; book maintenance, estimation and reconciliation; assurance evidence preparation; and controlled automation of repetitive analyses. The analyst independently executes clearly defined workstreams, while the inventory owner retains responsibility for methodology, quality control and final sign\-off.


**Job Responsibilities**

* **Data collection and validation —** run the multi\-cycle collection process across GHG inventory, covering several hundred data points; validate figures, investigate prior\-year and variance discrepancies, and keep internal data providers internal teams engaged and responsive.
* **Book maintenance, estimation and reconciliation —** maintain the GHG inventory and the supporting carbon accounting systems; assist in producing interim full\-year estimates from part\-year data, reconcile to actuals, document variances and maintain version control so the correct figures reach the correct audience.
* **Assurance evidence preparation —** prepare evidence and documentation for multiple external assurance processes, support walkthroughs, respond to queries and keep the full inventory and methodology documentation at an assurance\-ready standard year\-round.
* **Controlled automation —** build and maintain tooling that automates repetitive analyses such as business travel, office attendance and ledger clean\-up, and improve datasets, dashboards and reporting processes to strengthen data quality.

**Qualifications**

* 1 \- 3 years of relevant experience in data analysis, sustainability reporting, environmental data or a related area.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with experience managing, analysing and reconciling large datasets
* A strong data orientation — comfortable working with large datasets, spotting anomalies building repeatable, well\-controlled processes.
* Working knowledge of the GHG Protocol (basic or university\-level is sufficient) and a interest or experience in sustainability reporting.
* Confidence using technology and AI to automate repeatable work and build reliable tooling around routine analyses.
* Strong attention to detail, initiative and reliability: able to take a task from instruction through to completion in a deadline\-driven cycle, escalating issues where necessary.
* A self\-starter who is organized and capable of working independently while collaborating with global stakeholders.

Deep technical GHG expertise is less important than the ability to learn quickly, work methodically and build dependable processes, though a foundational understanding of GHG Protocol will be needed for the role.

description:
**:**

The **Channel Order Management \& Analytics Leader** is responsible for managing the overall health of the Channel organization's global open order book and leading the team supporting order management activities. This role plays a critical role within the Channel Supply Chain organization, ensuring seamless coordination between distribution partners and TE's internal Business Units (PBUs) and manufacturing plants.


Channel operates in a unique supply chain environment where distribution partners, including Arrow, TTI, Mouser, Avnet, Heilind, and others, serve as customers, while TE's PBUs and plants act as internal suppliers. This position is accountable for driving the end\-to\-end supply chain flow between these stakeholders, ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfaction.


The successful candidate will oversee and optimize a complex order management operation, improve supply chain visibility, and drive process excellence. In addition, the role will lead the transformation of current operational processes toward a more proactive, analytics\-driven, and automated operating model. This includes leveraging data, technology, and automation solutions to improve efficiency, scalability, accuracy, and decision\-making.


The role requires a proven supply chain professional with the ability to operate effectively across all levels of the organization, from detailed operational execution and planner\-level problem solving to strategic decision\-making and executive stakeholder engagement.


Based on the selected candidate's experience, leadership capability, and demonstrated business impact, the position may be filled at either the **Supervisor** or **Manager** level.


**Roles \& Responsibility:**
----------------------------


**PILLAR 1 \- Own \& Run the Operation \- Order \& Supplier Management**


**Distributor\-Facing Order Health**

  

* Own the health of the Channel open order book, including order intake, confirmations, past\-due aging, exception aging, and OTIF delivery across 10\-14 analysts.
* Manage distributor backlog and exceptions, including past\-due orders, unconfirmed lines, blocked orders, and expedites.
* Support distributor\-specific supply chain activities, including drop\-ship and stock orders, DTAM/design\-registration demand, inventory pulls, and allocation commitments.
* Champion the TE Customer Value Proposition (CVP) to improve customer and distributor experience.
* Ensure SAP execution discipline, including schedule lines, ATP, recommit dates, ABCON/Ship Note validation, and Late Reason Codes.
  

**Internal Supplier Management \& Collaboration**

  

* Own the Channel\-to\-BU supplier scorecard, including confirmation adherence, lead\-time compliance, fill rates, and recovery performance.
* Establish recurring reviews with PBU planners, schedulers, and supply planning teams.
* Build collaborative relationships with BUs and plants to proactively identify and resolve constraints.
* Translate supply constraints into distributor impact and drive mitigation plans.
* Act as the escalation bridge between Channel, BUs, Customer Care, and distributors.
  

**PILLAR 2 \- Transform the Operating Model**

  

* Shift the team from reactive issue resolution to proactive prevention using early\-warning analytics.
* Re\-engineer daily operations to provide analysts with prioritized work queues and reduce manual preparation effort.
* Deploy Power BI dashboards that predict risks and support decision\-making.
* Create planner\-focused views for response aging, recommit tracking, ATP failures, and pending actions.
* Lead change management while maintaining operational performance and service levels.
  

**PILLAR 3 \- Institutionalize Process, Automation \& AI**


**Automation \& AI Adoption**

  

* Drive the automation roadmap using Power BI, Fabric, and Power Query while maintaining SAP as the system of record.
* Replace manual Excel\-based cleansing, exception handling, and work allocation with automation.
* Implement AI\-driven logic, including exception flags, ATP failure indicators, risk scoring, Next Best Action recommendations, and predictive delay management.
* Deliver phased solutions, including automated prioritization, dashboards, workflow automation, and future\-state Power Apps capabilities.
  

**Process, Records \& Compliance**

  

* Standardize and document SOPs for all order management activities.
* Develop auditable tracking and record\-keeping processes for data intake, task logging, and status history.
* Standardize exception codes, aging buckets, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Modernize FTZ program maintenance through automated tracking, reconciliation, and compliance management.
* Standardize SAP update procedures and controls to ensure accurate, repeatable, and audit\-ready execution.
  
**Desired Candidate Profile:**
------------------------------


* **5\-8\+ years of progressive supply chain experience** in Order Management, Backlog Management, Materials Planning, Supply Planning, or Customer Operations.
* **Prior people management experience** as a Supervisor, Team Lead, or Manager (**mandatory**).
* **Strong SAP expertise (SD/MM modules)** with the ability to drive accurate order execution and coach team members. Exposure to **SAP IBP** is an added advantage.
* **Advanced Power BI and Advanced Excel skills** for reporting, analytics, and decision\-making.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Bachelor's Degree in **Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field**.
* Strong English communication skills (written and verbal).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in **Distribution or Channel Supply Chain Operations**, preferably in electronic components or distributor\-facing environments.
* Proven experience in **Supply Chain Digital Transformation**, including automation initiatives using **Power BI, Power Query/Fabric, Power Automate, and Power Apps**.
* Ability to think strategically and redesign operating models while managing day\-to\-day execution.
* Experience managing supplier relationships and cross\-functional stakeholders, including KPI and scorecard ownership.
* Knowledge of **FTZ (Foreign Trade Zone)** and Trade Compliance processes.
* Exposure to **AI/ML\-enabled decision support**, Business Objects, APICS CPIM/CSCP, Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma methodologies.
